# TR Lights

> Christmas light installation and permanent Govee lights for 1, 2 and 3-story homes in Ocean County and Monmouth County, New Jersey. Based in Toms River. Fully insured. Lights included, cut to fit, installed and taken down after the holidays. Free quote by text: (732) 955-1026.

## Services

- [Christmas light installation](https://www.trlightsnj.com/index.md): lights included, cut to fit your roofline, installed for the season and taken down in January
- [Permanent lights](https://www.trlightsnj.com/permanent-lights.md): Govee permanent lights under the roofline, any color from your phone, all year
- [Service areas](https://www.trlightsnj.com/service-areas.md): Toms River, Brick, Point Pleasant, Lakewood, Jackson, Seaside, Lavallette, Bayville, Forked River, Barnegat, Manasquan, Wall, Belmar, Howell, Freehold, Red Bank, Middletown and all of Ocean & Monmouth County, NJ
